title: CI pipeline fails on main after cache upgrade
body: The build job times out on every run since the runner cache changed.

title: Deployments to staging hang
body: Kubernetes rollout never finishes; pods stay pending.

title: API latency spiked to 4s
body: p95 latency on the orders endpoint jumped after the database migration.

title: Production down: 502 from every server
body: All users see server errors. Outage started 09:00.

title: Flaky integration test in pipeline
body: The payments integration test fails roughly one run in ten, rerun passes.

title: Docker image too large
body: Image grew to 2GB which slows deployments. Nice to have a slimmer base.

title: Database connection pool exhausted
body: Under load the service throws timeouts; restarting the pods is a workaround.

title: Nightly build broken
body: Builds fail with out of memory on the infrastructure runners, blocked release.

title: Cache invalidation is slow
body: Changes take ten minutes to appear because caching TTL is high.

title: Data loss after failed migration
body: A database migration dropped rows for some tenants. Production data loss.

title: Autoscaling does not trigger
body: Kubernetes HPA ignores CPU spikes so latency climbs.

title: Speed up CI
body: Pipelines take 25 minutes; could we parallelise the test jobs?

title: Submit button overlaps footer on mobile
body: On mobile view the button sits on top of the footer layout.

title: Dark mode text unreadable
body: In dark mode the CSS sets grey text on a grey card.

title: Keyboard focus lost in modal
body: Keyboard users cannot reach the close button; screen reader announces nothing. Accessibility blocker.

title: Page renders blank in Safari
body: The settings page shows nothing in Safari browser rendering; no workaround.

title: Icon misaligned in header
body: The logo is two pixels off. Cosmetic.

title: Table layout breaks at 1024px
body: Columns overflow the page at tablet width.

title: Missing alt text on charts
body: Screen reader users get no description of the dashboard charts.

title: Dropdown flickers on hover
body: Minor polish: menu flickers when the pointer moves quickly.

title: Checkout page unusable for all users
body: Buttons do nothing after the UI release; every browser affected.

title: Add loading spinner to search page
body: The page feels frozen while results load. Nice to have.

title: Contrast fails WCAG on links
body: Link colour contrast is 3:1 on the pricing page.

title: Form errors appear under the wrong field
body: Validation messages render beside the email field instead of the password field.

title: XSS in comment preview
body: Comment markdown preview executes script tags. Exploit confirmed.

title: Token printed in CI logs
body: A deploy token is visible in the build log output.

title: Bump lodash for CVE advisory
body: Dependency advisory: lodash prototype pollution CVE.

title: Users can see other orgs' projects
body: Access control check missing on the projects API; permissions bypass.

title: Login session never expires
body: Authentication cookies have no expiry, sessions live forever.

title: SQL injection in search filter
body: The sort parameter is concatenated into the query. Injection possible.

title: Rotate leaked API key
body: An api key was committed to a public branch last week.

title: Password reset email reveals account existence
body: The reset form says whether an email is registered.

title: Enable secret scanning push protection
body: We should block secrets before they land in the repo.

title: Outdated TLS configuration
body: The ingress still allows TLS 1.0.

title: Typo in README install section
body: 'instal' should be 'install'.

title: Broken link in contributing guide
body: The link to the code of conduct returns 404.

title: API reference wrong for pagination
body: The guide says page starts at 1 but the API reference wording implies 0.

title: Add example for webhook setup
body: A tutorial with a worked example would help new users.

title: Quickstart guide skips auth step
body: Following the guide fails because it never explains creating a token.

title: Outdated screenshots in docs
body: Guides show the old navigation.

title: Clarify rate limit wording
body: The documentation is confusing about per-minute versus per-hour limits.

title: Missing migration guide for v3
body: Users are blocked upgrading because there are no docs for breaking changes.

title: Login page slow and misaligned
body: The login form loads slowly and the button is misaligned.

title: Docs site deploy failing
body: The documentation site build fails in the CI pipeline.

title: Security headers missing from docs site
body: The docs pages send no CSP header.

title: Error page leaks stack trace
body: The 500 page shows a stack trace with internal paths to users.

title: README says to disable TLS verification
body: The troubleshooting guide tells users to turn off certificate checks.

title: Accessibility docs are out of date
body: The guide on keyboard navigation describes the old modal.
